caption: find your sign. tag the one who's in tier one. mercury stations retrograde at 6° pisces today, direct mar 3.

slides.headline: *mercury* turns backwards today. here's who feels it
it looks like *mercury* slides back for three weeks
slides.body: earth is overtaking mercury on the inside track. from 6° pisces it appears to drift back into aquarius on feb 18, then turns direct at 20.9° aquarius on mar 3.

rows.label: pisces
rows.text: it starts in your sign. re-read everything.

rows.label: aquarius
rows.text: it backs into you feb 18. old friends return.

rows.label: virgo
rows.text: it faces your sign. partners want a redo.

rows.label: gemini
rows.text: work messages need a second look.

rows.label: leo
rows.text: an ex's name comes up. you can let it.

rows.label: taurus
rows.text: a friend owes you a reply.

rows.label: scorpio
rows.text: old flirt, new context. go slow.

slides.headline: re-read before you *re-send*.
slides.body: the ex isn't back. the pattern is. save this until march 3.
